title: Kit vs. Mailchimp: Which is best? [2026]
summary: Looking to choose between Kit and Mailchimp for your email marketing campaign? Our breakdown will guide you in the right direction.
body_markdown:
**Kit**


**Mailchimp**


**User experience**


⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Incredibly simple; everything is designed for non-techies who want to focus on their audience rather than adjusting email settings


⭐⭐⭐⭐ Beginner-friendly; still, there's a learning curve simply due to how many features Mailchimp has


**Automation**


⭐⭐⭐⭐ Kit's "if this, then that" automations can be done in seconds; more complex visual automations are still easy to use, but not as in-depth as Mailchimp


⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Powerful automation features like conditional logic, multi-step sequences, cross-channel triggers, and AI-enhanced workflows


**Design**


⭐⭐⭐⭐ Gorgeous creator-produced templates and easy design process; not many templates and fewer customization options than Mailchimp


⭐⭐⭐⭐ Total design freedom (maybe too much?) plus 250+ templates ranging from modern to old-school


**Growth and monetization**


⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Kit is built to help creators make money, with features like newsletter cross-promotion, sponsorships, paid subscriptions, digital product delivery, tip collection, and more


⭐⭐ You can definitely hack together ways to make money from your email list, but it's not as useful or holistic as what Kit offers


**eCommerce**


⭐⭐⭐ Not designed for high-volume eCommerce, though it does have a native Shopify integration and abandoned cart sequences


⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A fully capable email companion for your eCommerce efforts, with cart abandonment sequences, product targeting, and deep connections to Shopify and others


**Digital products**


⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Native digital products sales and delivery, subscriptions, payment processing; it's all built into the platform


⭐⭐ Requires third-party integrations for digital product sales; not optimized for this use case


**AI features**


⭐⭐⭐⭐ Kit MCP lets you create campaigns, analyze data, and manage subscribers from AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT


⭐⭐⭐ Built-in AI generates content and runs predictive analytics, but features like AI automation building are underdeveloped


**Analytics**


⭐⭐⭐⭐ Insights Dashboard and Subscriber Signals are available on the Pro plan, offering deep analytics and enriching your list so you know more about each subscriber


⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Custom reporting, revenue tracking, campaign performance dashboards, and AI-driven predictive analytics like churn risk and purchase likelihood


**Pricing**


⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Best-in-class free plan for up to 10,000 subscribers with unlimited sending (but no automations); paid plans start at $39/month for 1,000 contacts


⭐⭐⭐ Limited free plan for 250 contacts; paid plans start at $13/month for 500 contacts; Mailchimp gets pricier than Kit once you scale past 5,000 contacts


**Integrations**


⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 100+ native integrations, plus more in the Kit App Store; connects to thousands of other apps via Zapier


⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 300+ integrations covering website builders, eCommerce platforms, and customer service tools; integrates with thousands of other apps via Zapier
